We require significant working capital requirements in our business operations and such delays in the collection of receivables or inadequate recovery on our claims could adversely affect our business, cash flows, financial condition and results of operations.
We have historically relied on borrowings to fund our working capital requirements and capital expenditures, resulting in a high level of debt.

If we experience insufficient cash flows or are unable to obtain suitable financing to meet working capital requirements, our business, financial condition and results of operations could be adversely affected.

A significant portion of our cash flow is dedicated to servicing our debt obligations, which reduces the availability of funds for working capital, capital expenditures, acquisitions, and other general corporate purposes.

Our Company intends to use the Net Proceeds from the Fresh Issue towards funding the following objects: • Purchase of equipment; • Prepayment and/or repayment, in full or in part, of all or a portion of certain outstanding borrowings availed by our Company; and • General Corporate Purposes.
